resources.string: The app needs all the permissions below to work properly. Press \"Grant all permissions\". On every screen that opens, allow the permission and come back. The remaining screens open one after another. When everything is granted, press Next.

If the Accessibility switch is grey or will not turn on: in App info, open the three-dot menu at the top and choose \"Allow restricted settings\". On Android 13 and above this is needed once for apps installed from an APK.
All permissions are granted. Press Next.
In App info, open \"Permissions\" and allow all the rest, then come back.
